item.title: Itadaki! Nyannyan China
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: TranceSoft
  • 発売日: 2009-09-18
  • スコア: 6.1/10 (14 人評価)
  • 日本語名: いただき！娘娘チャイナ
  • 英語名: Itadaki! Nyannyan China

あらすじ

Toru is a manager of a Chinese restaurant. One day, he gets injured in a traffic accident. Chiyuki, who is the cause of the accident, is actually a misfortune girl. Days later, Chiyuki’s house is destroyed by a fire…. Toru offers her to work at his restaurant temporarily. Ayaka, her younger sister, objects to his offer, but Chiyuki starts working there until she finds a house to live. One day, Chiyuki reads a magazine during break time. The magazine says, “If you meet a man whose blood type is A and the signs of zodiac is the Fishes today, you’ll fall in love with him.” Chiyuki asks to Toru, “Your blood type is A, isn’t it?” “Oh…!” Chiyuki also knows that Toru’s signs of zodiac is the Fishes…. Since then, Chiyuki starts approaching Toru with a help of Ayaka….

item.title: Onedari Onapet
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: TranceSoft
  • 発売日: 2009-07-31
  • スコア: 6.2/10 (7 人評価)
  • 日本語名: おねだりオナペット
  • 英語名: Onedari Onapet

あらすじ

One day, Yusaku receives a big package. When he approaches it, a siren rings and it opens. There is a girl lying inside…. She looks like just a girl, but she has big ears and a long tail. Yes, she is a hybrid organic creature called “i-do Type F”. As a matter of fact, he applied for a monitoring campaign for the i-do Type F a few weeks ago. She wakes up and tells him to name her. He decides to call her Felis. Like this, his life with Felis starts now….
